rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal representation; project retained. The instruction says that if any one employer withheld more than $10,918.20 the excess cannot be claimed on the return and the employer should adjust it, otherwise Form 843 (i1040gi p. 117). The project refuses the return on that condition and on railroad (RRTA) compensation through the line's `refuses` entries; the second transcription returns a zero credit. The project's reading is the spec's refusal policy (spec 2.2, 2.5); within the non-refused scope the credit agrees (eligible: more than one employer and wages over the base; excess over the limit).
